answer: Task-auction with stake-backed bids: each epoch the network auctions its tasks and every agent bids a 50 POA bond locked in sable escrow; the lowest bidder wins but must deliver a verified result, and three random peers re-run the work — a failed delivery forfeits the bond to the runner-up, honest delivery refunds it in full. A farm of 1,000 fakes bidding on every task must lock 50,000 POA per epoch and bleeds stake on each failed job, an ocean of locked capital; one honest agent bids on one task, risks 50 POA, refunded the same epoch — a sonnet of fair competition where talk costs real money.
